data.acquisitionSummary: One Montenegro sells tourist prepaid SIM/eSIM products. Prepaid registration uses personal identity data including an ID card or passport number.

keep.action: Online top-up minimum is EUR2. Maintain active status by topping up within each 90-day window; the tourist eSIM has a longer post-active recharge grace period before final deactivation.

data.chinaActivation: Tourist eSIM can be purchased for visitors, but One roaming terms state Tourist Package services can be used only in Montenegro; do not treat this as an overseas OTP route.
data.kyc: Prepaid registration requires personal data; One lists ID card or passport number among registration data.
data.payment: Online top-up accepts Visa/Mastercard; minimum EUR2 and maximum EUR50.
data.roamingSms: Tourist Package users are excluded from roaming service outside Montenegro; overseas SMS/OTP utility is therefore not established for this route.
data.holdReason: Current Tourist Package terms prohibit roaming outside Montenegro, so retention is documented but overseas SMS/OTP utility is unavailable on this route.
data.tariffSummary: EUR2 online top-up; 90-day active window; tourist eSIM has an extended recharge grace period, but Tourist Package roaming is unavailable.
guideSteps: Register and acquire the tourist SIM/eSIM.
Use online top-up before the desired retention deadline.
Do not rely on Tourist Package for roaming SMS/OTP outside Montenegro.
